name: scenario1_python_bulk_rnaseq_qc_pca
cells:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n_genes, n_samples = 40, 8
group = np.array(["Ctrl"] * 4 + ["IRI"] * 4)
# Synthetic count-like matrix: 40 genes x 8 samples, IRI up in ~40% of genes
base = rng.negative_binomial(5, 0.3, size=(n_genes, n_samples))
mask_iri_up = rng.random(n_genes) < 0.4
base[mask_iri_up, 4:] *= 3
counts = pd.DataFrame(base, columns=[f"S{i+1}" for i in range(n_samples)])
meta = pd.DataFrame({"sample": counts.columns, "group": group})
counts.to_csv("bioqa_counts.csv", index=True)
meta.to_csv("bioqa_meta.csv", index=False)
print("counts shape:", counts.shape, "| groups:", meta["group"].value_counts().to_dict())

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

counts = pd.read_csv("bioqa_counts.csv", index_col=0)
meta = pd.read_csv("bioqa_meta.csv")
# log-CPM normalization with a small pseudocount
lib = counts.sum(axis=0)
cpm = counts.divide(lib, axis=1) * 1e6
logcpm = np.log2(cpm + 1.0)
# PCA via SVD on mean-centered log-CPM (genes x samples)
X = logcpm.subtract(logcpm.mean(axis=1), axis=0).to_numpy()
U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False)
pcs = Vt[:2].T * S[:2]  # n_samples x 2
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(pcs, columns=["PC1", "PC2"], index=counts.columns)
pca_df["group"] = meta.set_index("sample").loc[counts.columns, "group"].values
var_ratio = (S[:5] ** 2 / (S ** 2).sum()).round(3)
print("explained variance ratio (PC1-PC5):", var_ratio.tolist())

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

color_map = {"Ctrl": "#1f77b4", "IRI": "#d62728"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4))
for g, sub in pca_df.groupby("group"):
    ax.scatter(sub["PC1"], sub["PC2"], c=color_map[g], label=g, s=60, edgecolor="k")
ax.set_xlabel("PC1")
ax.set_ylabel("PC2")
ax.set_title("Synthetic bulk RNA-seq PCA (log-CPM, SVD)")
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("bioqa_pca.png", dpi=120)
pca_df.to_csv("bioqa_pca.csv")
plt.close(fig)
print("wrote bioqa_pca.png and bioqa_pca.csv")

name: scenario2_r_exploratory_de_synthetic
cells:
set.seed(2024)
n_genes <- 40
n_samples <- 8
group <- factor(c(rep("Ctrl", 4), rep("IRI", 4)))
# Synthetic log-expression matrix: 40 genes x 8 samples;
# ~30% of genes shifted up in IRI (NOT a validated pipeline).
log_expr <- matrix(rnorm(n_genes * n_samples, mean = 7, sd = 1.2),
                   nrow = n_genes, ncol = n_samples)
de_idx <- sample.int(n_genes, size = round(0.3 * n_genes))
log_expr[de_idx, 5:8] <- log_expr[de_idx, 5:8] + 1.8
colnames(log_expr) <- paste0("S", seq_len(n_samples))
rownames(log_expr) <- paste0("g", seq_len(n_genes))
meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(log_expr), group = group, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(log_expr), "bioqa_logexpr.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(meta, "bioqa_meta.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("log_expr dim:", dim(log_expr), "\n")

logexpr_df <- read.csv("bioqa_logexpr.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("bioqa_meta.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctrl_samples <- meta$sample[meta$group == "Ctrl"]
iri_samples  <- meta$sample[meta$group == "IRI"]
welch_one <- function(row, grp_a, grp_b) {
  tryCatch({
    a <- as.numeric(row[grp_a])
    b <- as.numeric(row[grp_b])
    tt <- t.test(a, b)
    c(log2fc = mean(b) - mean(a), pvalue = tt$p.value)
  }, error = function(e) c(log2fc = NA_real_, pvalue = NA_real_))
}
res <- t(apply(logexpr_df, 1, welch_one, ctrl_samples, iri_samples))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$gene  <- rownames(logexpr_df)
res$padj <- p.adjust(res$pvalue, method = "BH")
res$significant <- res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2fc) > 1
cat("DE genes (BH<0.05 & |log2FC|>1):", sum(res$significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    "of", nrow(res), "\n")

png("bioqa_volcano.png", width = 700, height = 500)
plot(res$log2fc, -log10(res$padj),
     xlab = "log2 fold-change (IRI vs Ctrl)",
     ylab = "-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)",
     main = "Synthetic exploratory DE - volcano",
     pch = 19, col = ifelse(res$significant, "firebrick", "grey55"))
abline(v = c(-1, 1), lty = 2, col = "grey40")
abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2, col = "grey40")
legend("topright", legend = c("significant", "n.s."),
       col = c("firebrick", "grey55"), pch = 19, bty = "n")
dev.off()
write.csv(res, "bioqa_de.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote bioqa_volcano.png and bioqa_de.csv\n")

name: scenario3_r_geneset_overlap_base
cells:
set.seed(7)
# Synthetic gene universe of 200 symbols; four overlapping sets.
universe <- paste0("g", sprintf("%03d", 1:200))
pick <- function(n) sort(sample(universe, size = n))
sets <- list(
  inflammation = pick(35),
  fibrosis     = pick(30),
  apoptosis    = pick(28),
  mitochon     = pick(22)
)
saveRDS(sets, "bioqa_sets.rds")
long_df <- data.frame(gene = unlist(sets, use.names = FALSE),
                      set  = rep(names(sets), sapply(sets, length)),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(long_df, "bioqa_sets_long.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("sets:", names(sets), "| sizes:", sapply(sets, length), "\n")

sets <- readRDS("bioqa_sets.rds")
# Closure over set names + pairwise combinatorics
size_of <- function(nm) data.frame(set = nm, size = length(sets[[nm]]),
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
size_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), size_of))

pair_names <- combn(names(sets), 2, simplify = FALSE)
pair_rows <- lapply(pair_names, function(p) {
  a <- sets[[p[1]]]; b <- sets[[p[2]]]
  inter <- length(intersect(a, b))
  uni   <- length(union(a, b))
  data.frame(set_a = p[1], set_b = p[2],
             n_intersect = inter, n_union = uni,
             jaccard = inter / uni, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
overlap_df <- do.call(rbind, pair_rows)
overlap_df <- merge(overlap_df, size_df, by.x = "set_a", by.y = "set")
cat("pairwise rows:", nrow(overlap_df), "| mean jaccard:",
    round(mean(overlap_df$jaccard), 3), "\n")

out_png <- file.path(getwd(), "bioqa_overlap.png")
out_csv <- file.path(getwd(), "bioqa_overlap.csv")
png(out_png, width = 700, height = 500)
barplot(overlap_df$jaccard,
        names.arg = paste(overlap_df$set_a, overlap_df$set_b, sep = " vs "),
        las = 2, ylab = "Jaccard index",
        main = "Synthetic gene-set pairwise overlap",
        col = "steelblue")
dev.off()
write.csv(overlap_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", out_png, "and", out_csv, "\n")
